scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && nuxi dev playground
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare playground
scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run prepack && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:alpha: npm version prerelease --preid=alpha && npm publish --tag next --access public
scripts.release:beta: npm version prerelease --preid=beta && npm publish --tag next --access public
scripts.release:rc: npm version prerelease --preid=rc && npm publish --tag next --access public
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm publish --tag latest --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm publish --tag latest --access public
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm publish --tag latest --access public
